title.zh: Muse Wonder发布：Meta新智能体模型
title.en: Muse Wonder: Meta's New Agent Model

excerpt.zh: Muse Wonder是Meta面向个人和专业智能体的新前沿模型，重点提升记忆、持续执行和编码能力，但独立验证仍有限。
excerpt.en: Muse Wonder is Meta's new frontier model for personal and professional agents, emphasizing memory, sustained execution, and coding, with independent validation still limited.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Muse Wonder是Meta发布的新一代前沿模型系列，包括Muse Wonder和Muse Wonder Full，定位于个人与专业场景中的AI智能体。Meta称，这些模型将通过Meta Model API和Muse Code提供，其中Full版本面向Muse Code订阅者，并将在未来用于Muse产品体验和更复杂的生成流程。
text.en: Muse Wonder is Meta's new frontier model family, including Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, aimed at AI agents for personal and professional work. Meta says the models are available through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, with the Full version for Muse Code subscribers, and will later support Muse experiences and more complex generation workflows.

text.zh: Meta把这次发布放在“个人超级智能”的长期路线中解释。公司称模型训练依托其Prometheus数据中心，并在预训练和强化学习上延续Muse Spark之后的扩展策略。不过，公开材料主要来自Meta自己的博客与评测说明，外部复现和第三方对比仍是理解其真实能力的关键。
text.en: Meta frames the release as part of its longer path toward what it calls personal superintelligence. The company says the models were trained using its Prometheus data center and continue the scaling approach introduced after Muse Spark across pretraining and reinforcement learning. The public evidence, however, mainly comes from Meta's own blog and evaluation claims, so external replication and third-party comparisons remain important.

text.zh: Active Memory与Active Focus是核心卖点
text.en: Active Memory and Active Focus Are the Main Claims

text.zh: 这组模型的主要技术叙事集中在两点：Active Memory和Active Focus。前者强调跨对话保留重要上下文，并在相关任务中主动取回；后者强调在长期目标中持续尝试、处理阻碍、适应新信息，并在必要时要求澄清或在关键操作前确认。
text.en: The core technical story centers on Active Memory and Active Focus. Active Memory refers to carrying important context across conversations and retrieving it when relevant. Active Focus refers to persisting on longer goals, trying alternatives, working through blockers, adapting to new information, and asking for clarification or confirmation when needed.

text.zh: Meta还强调Muse Wonder在法律、金融、健康信息理解以及软件开发等任务上的表现，并提到Harvey的Legal Agent Benchmark、FocusBench和SWE-Marathon等评测。对开发者来说，最直接的看点是编码智能体能力：模型被描述为能跟踪需求、修改代码库，并经历测试和修订循环。
text.en: Meta also highlights performance on tasks involving legal, financial, and health information, along with software development, citing evaluations such as Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark, FocusBench, and SWE-Marathon. For developers, the clearest claim is coding-agent behavior: the model is described as tracking requirements, changing codebases, and moving through test-and-revision loops.

text.zh: 能力提升之外，隐私与安全仍待观察
text.en: Beyond Capability, Privacy and Safety Need Scrutiny

text.zh: 如果个人智能体要操作浏览器、应用、日历、消息或私人文档，模型能力只是问题的一半。Meta称Muse Wonder在私密信息处理、抵御恶意指令、CBRN和网络滥用防护方面进行了强化，并会发布更完整的安全评测报告。
text.en: If a personal agent can work across browsers, apps, calendars, messages, or private documents, model capability is only half the issue. Meta says Muse Wonder has been strengthened for private-information handling, resistance to adversarial instructions, and safeguards against CBRN and cyber misuse, with a fuller safety report still to come.

text.zh: 当前最大的开放问题是，这些能力在真实用户环境中是否稳定，尤其是在长期任务、敏感数据和多工具操作同时出现时。Muse Wonder的发布显示大模型竞争正从聊天回答转向可执行任务的智能体，但其可靠性、权限边界和独立评测结果，将决定它是否能超越演示阶段。
text.en: The main open question is whether these capabilities remain stable in real user environments, especially when long tasks, sensitive data, and multiple tools are involved at the same time. Muse Wonder shows that model competition is shifting from chat responses toward agents that can act, but reliability, permission boundaries, and independent evaluation will determine whether it moves beyond impressive demos.
